attack_rows.principle: Outcome leakage, authority substitution, and spelling drift fail closed.

context_control_contract.principle: Clean, repair, and neutral contexts are byte-frozen and length accounted.

downstream_gate_field_rows.principle: Every exact field name is owned by an upstream task in this roadmap.

duration_s.principle: Monotonic duration exposes truncated source or fixture work.

field_provenance.principle: Every protocol field names its source, rows, hashes, and reducer.

gate_check_summary.principle: Any block names the missing source, fixture, registry, or contract field.

honest_verdict.principle: The verdict states source-method and joint-method readiness separately.

inference_substrate.principle: The task declares primary-source and exact-fixture replay with no LLM.

joint_method_replay_rows.principle: The clean Exp6574 method remains executable on positive and negative fixtures.

learning_arm_contract.principle: Frozen, uniform, graph-Potts, protected-core, and conflict-routed arms are prospective.

non_imported_claim_rows.principle: External benchmark and hardware claims cannot enter Carnot evidence.

preconditions_checked.principle: Source, fixture, registry, resource, and protected-file receipts are explicit.

primary_source_receipts.principle: Each borrowed method has an immutable source and a bounded Carnot hook.

prompt_seed_budget_contract.principle: All families receive the same preregistered work.

proof_arm_contract.principle: No-filter, atomic, and joint-graph arms have matched inputs and costs.

protected_files_unchanged.principle: The protocol preserves both protected orchestration files.

reproducibility_checksum.principle: A final hash protects the frozen protocol.

source_unit_manifest.principle: Exact bytes, hashes, split, and inclusion rules freeze the evaluation before inference.

status.principle: The protocol closes before any V572 model outcome.

tests_run.principle: Named commands, exits, and durations make preregistration reproducible.

v572_joint_method_ready_score.principle: This exact binary field gates the joint-proof comparison.

v572_source_method_ready_score.principle: This exact binary field gates all three family shard tasks.

verdict_class.principle: Preregistration is null infrastructure, not positive science.

verifier_is_oracle.principle: Exact method replay is infrastructure authority and cannot create positive science.
